semantically_equivalent_models.justification: The given model itself is always semantically equivalent to itself and is usually listed to clarify a baseline.

parent_models.justification: As part of the GPT-2 series, gpt2-small is a broader category encompassing models with varying parameter sizes, and one of the parent models.
GPT is the general family from which all specific instances like GPT-2, GPT-3 etc., are derived, making it a parent model.
Represents a category for large GPT models beyond the specific size variations, thus can be seen as a parent model to gpt2-large.
While later in the series than GPT-2 models, GPT-3 represents a broader group of advancements from the original GPT model, serving as an indirect parent in terms of progression.

closest_parent_model.justification: GPT, as a foundational model, is the most immediate and broad classification encompassing all versions and sizes within the GPT family, including gpt2-large as a descendant.

child_models.justification: A streamlined and lighter version of the GPT-2 series, distilgpt2 is derived from extensive versions like gpt2-large, making it a child model.

closest_child_model.justification: Being a direct derivation of the GPT-2 family with reduced parameters and optimized for performance, distilgpt2 embodies a specific instance that is tightly linked to gpt2-large.

sibling_models.justification: Another model in the GPT-2 family with a size slight larger than gpt2-large, placing it as a logical sibling.

closest_sibling_model.justification: Within the GPT-2 family, gpt2-xlarge offers a slightly bigger alternative, making it very similar and hence the most immediate sibling.

unrelated_models.justification: A distinct iteration in the GPT lineage, marked as unrelated to gpt2-large due to its focus on different advancements and size.
Part of a newer line of GPT models (post-GPT-3), marking it unrelated to the specific GPT-2 version like gpt2-large.
A parallel version in the AI model development not directly related to GPT-2 line models, thus unrelated.
Represents a branch of models extended from GPT-3, not directly connected with GPT-2 lines.
Another iteration beyond GPT-2 development, marking a distinct, unrelated series.
Represents the scale of a different model set, distinct from the GPT-2 timeline.
A specialized extension from GPT-3, unrelated to the GPT-2 series.

Aligned with the GPT-4 evolutionary series, distinguishing it from the GPT-2 segment.

Developed independently and represents another range of models not involving GPT-2 characteristics.
